target.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab
target.body:
Stack 2 of 4. Depends on #101253.

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix QA scenarios and profile selection still live in the legacy `qa-matrix`
runner, so QA Lab cannot own or validate the complete Matrix catalog through the
same declarative flow system used by other channel drivers.

## Why This Change Was Made

Move the Matrix scenario implementations, Docker substrate, and 94-scenario
parity catalog into QA Lab, with deterministic profile selection and
module-backed YAML flows. Keep `qa-matrix` as a thin CLI/registration shim for
the remaining stacked callers; workflow migration and package removal stay in
successor PRs 3 and 4.

## User Impact

There is no production messaging behavior change. QA maintainers get one
canonical Matrix scenario catalog in QA Lab, while the existing
`openclaw qa matrix` command and generic live Matrix adapter remain compatible
during the stack.

## Evidence

- Parity tests cover all 94 legacy scenario ids: 81 module-backed Matrix flows
  plus 13 intentional mappings to portable QA Lab scenarios.
- Profile tests preserve the legacy counts and explicit-only exclusions.
- Blacksmith Testbox focused proof passed 24 files / 232 tests across QA Lab,
  the compatibility shim, and the plugin SDK runtime surface.
- The real release-profile command passed 2/2 Docker-backed scenarios on
  Blacksmith Testbox: `channel-chat-baseline` and
  `matrix-allowlist-hot-reload`.
- Exact-head changed-surface proof passed all static guards and the full `tsgo`
  project build. The two lint diagnostics were fixed and rechecked with focused
  tests plus zero-warning targeted lint.
- Fresh autoreview completed clean after the fixes, with no accepted or
  actionable findings.
